findings.title: Hardcoded JWT secret in source
findings.description: The JWT secret is embedded directly in the source code, making it visible in version control.
findings.impact: Any developer with repo access can extract the secret and forge tokens.
findings.recommendation: Move the secret to an environment variable and inject it at runtime.

findings.title: Missing rate limit on login endpoint
findings.description: The login route does not enforce any rate limiting, leaving it open to brute-force attacks.

findings.title: O(n²) loop in job deduplication
findings.description: The deduplication logic uses nested loops over the full job array.
findings.evidence: for (let i = 0; i < jobs.length; i++) { for (let j = 0; j < jobs.length; j++) { ... } }
findings.impact: Queue processing time grows quadratically with job count, causing timeouts under load.
findings.recommendation: Replace with a Set-based lookup or maintain a hash map of seen job IDs.
